evidence: 0.102.3101 on Windows 10, elevated, laptop plus two external monitors; AltSnap uses Win+drag.
At a monitor corner a thin border appears and drag stalls; exiting PowerToys fixes it, while disabling most Windowing and Layouts modules does not.
The November 16 follow-up explicitly says Grab and Move is disabled; Always On Top and Workspaces were retained in the earlier test.

Grab and Move modifier/mouse-hook implementation is relevant only as a control, not an established enabled cause: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/82bd57f5d23ee19a98b0c46f42c304742a7db426/src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp
The prior artifact's uncertainty about whether Grab and Move is enabled is superseded by the new author reply.
